title: ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox
abstract: arXiv:2610.14807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. translated_title: ASIWorld：在持久化生存沙盒中基准测试自主智能体
translated_abstract: 评估自主智能体需要考察它们能否在长时间交互中将目标转化为连贯的行动。在持久化环境中，这要求在不完全观测条件下协调相互依赖的行动，考虑延迟效应，并随着早期决策影响后续机会而不断适应。我们提出了ASIWorld，一个生存沙盒，它将持久化的世界与角色状态、角色范围的观测以及可编程的异步接口相结合，用于研究持续的目标执行。智能体通过直接行动或智能体自行编写的程序（这些程序在模型调用之间持续运行）来完成相互依赖的生产与探索任务。评估考察任务成功率、发展成就的达成以及生存成本，并辅以对执行行为的分析。在一项使用统一测试框架、针对九种智能体配置的探索性研究中，八个完成了……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ASIWorld，一个结合持久化世界与角色状态、角色范围观测和可编程异步接口的生存沙盒基准，用于评估自主智能体在不完全观测和延迟效应下长期持续执行相互依赖目标的能力。
en_tdlr: ASIWorld is a persistent survival sandbox benchmark that combines persistent world and character state, character-scoped observations, and a programmable asynchronous interface to evaluate whether autonomous agents can sustain coherent, interdependent goal execution over extended interactions.
